stem: What is the primary purpose of a loading dose?

options.A: To reach a target therapeutic concentration more rapidly than would occur with maintenance dosing alone
options.B: To eliminate the need for all future maintenance doses
options.C: To guarantee that toxicity cannot occur
options.D: To slow drug absorption for several days

rationale: A loading dose is used when rapid achievement of a target drug concentration is desired; it is followed by maintenance dosing as clinically indicated.
educational_objective: Explain the purpose of a loading dose in pharmacotherapy.
source_organization: National Library of Medicine / NCBI Bookshelf (StatPearls)
source_document_title: Drug Distribution and Loading Dose / Pharmacokinetics
source_locator: Loading dose concept — used to rapidly achieve target/therapeutic concentration
source_claim_supported: A loading dose is used to achieve a target therapeutic concentration rapidly.
blueprint_source_organization: National Council of State Boards of Nursing (NCSBN)
